title: x86_64 Vulnerability Framework
description: Engineered a vulnerable-by-design C environment to research memory corruption, demonstrating privilege escalation via partial RIP overwrites.

title: SUID Fullchain Bypass
description: A full-chain 64-bit Linux exploit chaining a Format String leak and Buffer Overflow to bypass ASLR, PIE, NX, and Canaries for SUID privilege escalation.

title: Algorithmic Cryptanalysis
description: Developed automated scripts to break Vigenère and Substitution ciphers, alongside solving the Discrete Logarithm Problem (DLP).
